verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a generic Events API that can record pageviews and custom events, explicitly usable for Android/iOS or server-side tracking, but the evidence pack shows no official SDKs for specific languages/platforms—just a raw HTTP API and a JS snippet/GTM/WordPress for web. Missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), official backend SDKs (Node, Python, Go, etc.), and any language-specific client libraries beyond the generic HTTP events endpoint.
